Hi Liam — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. Quick confirmation items from Redwood AP/tax: 

1) W-8BEN-E: we see the form and the signature via DocuSign. To complete our vendor file we need either:
   - A notarized wet-signature copy of the W-8BEN-E, OR
   - A company letter confirming the signer authority + a copy of the signer ID (passport/driver license) if you prefer to keep the DocuSign copy.

2) Company registry: perfect. We need the registration number written on the W-8 as "Foreign TIN" if you have one — otherwise please add a short statement in the email body confirming you do not have a foreign TIN.

3) VAT / invoice formatting: our system expects a VAT tag. If your AP requires the invoice to state "Reverse Charge" please confirm the exact wording and we can accept that in the invoice notes field.

4) Routing / payment release: AP will queue payment on receipt of either the notarized W-8 or authorized signatory affidavit + ID. Once cleared we will issue payment via international wire (our standard). If you need ACH or an alternate routing, include the banking form.

If it's easier, we can send a short signer affidavit template for Claire to sign and notarize — I can attach that now.

Thanks — Mina
